content: <thought>We have the molecular ion at m/z 127.0997 (likely [M+H]⁺), suggesting a neutral mass ≈ 126.09 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈ 8 % M+1) points to ~8 C atoms. A plausible formula fitting this mass is C₈H₁₄O (exact neutral mass 126.104 Da, [M+H]⁺ 127.112 Da) or C₇H₁₀O₂ (neutral 126.068 Da, [M+H]⁺ 127.075 Da). Both are close; further NMR data will discriminate. The next inexpensive step is to obtain the 13C NMR spectrum to see the number of distinct carbon environments, which will help decide between these candidates.
